task: Give your agent a separate browser, with page reading, interaction and screenshots

x-display.title: Give your agent a working browser
x-display.summary: Read websites, interact with pages and capture screenshots in a separate local browser.
x-display.description:
Your agent gets agent-browser’s MCP tools for opening pages, reading their contents and interacting with buttons and forms. The browser stays open between tools for the life of that connection.

For a first result, supply a page address and get its screenshot and readable accessibility snapshot. This browser has its own session: it does not inherit your usual browser’s accounts, extensions or saved passwords.

packaging_note: Checksummed official agent-browser 0.42.0 npm package with Debian Chromium on both architectures. Uses upstream's supported executable-path setting. MCP owns the browser session; independent command containers are deliberately not advertised.

inputs.what: a JSON object with url and optional width, height, full_page and wait_selector

outputs.what: a screenshot at the selected viewport or full page height
the page address, title, capture options and output checksums

mcp_servers.what: agent-browser's navigation, page interaction and capture tools; browser state lasts for this MCP connection

access.why: The separate browser loads websites and the resources they request.

known_issues: This is a headless CPU browser, not a connection to your signed-in desktop browser. Sites may require login or block automation.
Closing the MCP connection ends this browser process. Do not use it as persistent storage for an account or assume a new connection resumes an earlier page.
Chromium's sandbox is disabled inside the container. UGT's container boundary still applies; do not expose this MCP server as an unauthenticated public service.
licence: agent-browser Apache-2.0, with bundled notices; Chromium and its Debian dependencies retain their distribution notices. UGT's driver and checks are Apache-2.0.
